description: Price one PLANNED episode (30-60 seconds, 3-8 shots) of a series with a confirmed season plan, starring the character the plan names. FREE: it spends nothing and starts nothing. Returns the shot plan (narration, action, camera and seconds of every shot), the exact credits (clips are Seedance at the per-second rate of the chosen resolution: 480p by default, 720p only when quote.pricePerResolution lists it as available, plus a still per shot and the narration), and a ready-made nextAction for autoshort_create_character_episode. Show the customer the price and the shots, and call the create tool only after they say yes. The same safety checks as the real call run here: real or famous people, anyone who looks under 18, sexual content and protected characters are refused with CONTENT_POLICY. Only an episode of a REVIEWED, CONFIRMED season plan can be quoted or made: send its script or shots exactly as planned (autoshort_get_season_plan). Without a confirmed plan the answer is SEASON_PLAN_REQUIRED or SEASON_NOT_REVIEWED, and for shots that are not a planned episode EPISODE_NOT_IN_PLAN, each with a nextAction. The narrator voice, the language, the style and the character come from the plan and cannot be overridden (SEASON_FIELD_LOCKED); to change an episode, edit the plan (that clears the review).

language.description: Omit it: the narration language is the season plan's. If given it must equal the plan's.

resolution.description: Clip resolution. Default '480p'. '720p' costs more per second (see quote.pricePerResolution) and is only accepted when it is listed as available there; the quote and the create must use the same resolution.

script.description: The narration, about 74-138 words. The system splits it into shots by sentence. Give `script` OR `shots`.

seriesId.description: A series id from autoshort_list_series whose season plan is reviewed and confirmed.

sheetId.description: Omit it: the character sheet is the one the season plan names for this episode. If given it must equal that sheet.

shotCount.description: With `script`: how many shots to split it into. Omit for an automatic count.

shots.description: Shots you write yourself (better pictures than the automatic split). Give `shots` OR `script`.

action.description: What the viewer sees the character doing. Omit to illustrate the narration.

camera.description: Camera: wide shot, close-up, push-in, over-the-shoulder... Omit for an automatic choice.

narration.description: What the narrator says over this shot (at most about 29 words).

name: autoshort_quote_character_episode
